title.en: A similar answer need not imply similar conduct
title.zh: 相似回答未必意味着相似行为

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的一次社区活动中，两人都认为应当安慰遇到困难的人。一人先询问对方需要什么，另一人直接安排了一项自己认为有用的帮助。两人可能认同相同原则，帮助是否被需要、是否可行以及是否完成，仍是另外的问题。认同关怀命题不自动提供这些事实；对某句宽泛表述加上条件，也不等于赞成忽视困难。例子用于区分观点与应用，不评选谁更善良。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two participants at an invented community activity endorse comforting someone in difficulty. One asks what is wanted; another arranges help they expect to be useful. They may endorse the same principle while wantedness, feasibility and completion remain separate questions. Endorsement supplies none of those facts, and qualifying a broad statement need not endorse neglect. Distinguish a view from its application without ranking kindness.

title.zh: 用一个具体比较澄清理解

paragraphs.zh: 可写一张虚构讨论卡：“我认同的关怀原则”“仍需了解的需要”“我不能从分数知道的事”。问：“哪些信息来自对方明确表达，哪些只是推测？”分享卡片或公开指南即可，不要求朋友答题或用分数证明自己会照顾人。
paragraphs.en: Draft an invented discussion card with the principle endorsed, a need still to understand and what the score cannot tell. Ask which information was stated and which was inferred. Share the card or public guide without asking friends to test or using a score as proof of care.

title.en: One distribution does not define every case
title.zh: 一次分配不能代表所有情况

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构合作获得十二张无现金价值的纪念卡，三位成员讨论是否各分四张。有人想到共同参与应同等分享，有人担心这会不会被理解成对所有资源都采用同一规则。先说明分配对象、共有约定和这次讨论的范围，才能比较两种说法。赞成这次平分不证明赞成所有社会结果相同，反对某句普遍化命题也不能直接推出反对此次平分；六题均分不替真实争议定案。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, three collaborators receive twelve souvenir cards with no cash value and discuss four each. One thinks of equal sharing in a joint activity; another questions extending the rule to every resource. Name the resource, agreement and discussion scope. This equal split establishes no view on every social outcome, and reservations about a universal statement settle no view on this split. Six ratings decide no real dispute.

title.en: Clarify which meaning of equal you used
title.zh: 澄清自己采用了哪种平等含义

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构分配各写一句“我在分配什么”和“我没有据此断言什么”。再问：“如果只改变起点或需要，原先理由是否仍适用？”允许保留限定，不把回答修成单一政治身份，也不要求别人公开收入或私人条件。
paragraphs.en: For an invented allocation, state what is being divided and what you are not concluding from it. Ask whether changing only a starting condition or need changes the reason. Retain qualifications without forming a political identity or asking for income or private circumstances.

title.en: A high value cannot establish who contributed more
title.zh: 较高不能确定谁贡献更多

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构活动的一位成员花更多时间核对资料，另一位熟悉工具、用较少时间完成了更多条目。双方都赞成贡献应获认可，仍需说明此处贡献指时间、结果、协调还是承担的责任。量尺没有观察这些贡献，也不能用较高均分替任何人主张奖励。改变贡献的定义后判断变化，可能是在澄清条件，而不是证明一个人不诚实；例子也不决定实际薪酬或奖惩。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, one participant spends more time checking information while another knows the tools and finishes more entries sooner. Both endorse recognising contribution, yet need to specify time, output, coordination or responsibility. The scale observes none of these and authorises no reward claim through a high mean. A changed judgment after defining contribution differently can clarify conditions without proving dishonesty. The example determines no actual pay or sanctions.

title.en: Specify what you meant by contribution
title.zh: 说明自己所说的贡献是什么

paragraphs.zh: 可以给虚构任务画四栏：努力、成果、责任、未掌握的信息。只改一项已说明的条件，再看自己在比较什么。讨论句是：“我们认同同一个原则，还是把不同东西都叫贡献？”不需要调查同事、排名效率或据分数分配回报。
paragraphs.en: For an invented task, list effort, output, responsibility and missing information. Change one stated condition and identify what you compare. Ask whether the shared principle is the same or different things are called contribution. Investigate no colleagues, rank no productivity and allocate no reward from scores.

title.zh: 忠诚与批评可以同时存在

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的阅读社团原先约定让所有成员自愿参加。一位成员质疑后来增加的强制要求，因为认为它背离共同约定；另一位主张先保留安排以维持活动。两人都可能把自己的理由理解为关心社团，均分无法确定谁的事实判断正确，也不能评定谁有资格归属。这个自选社团例子只说明群体承诺与具体做法可分开，不替代题目中关于国家、共同体或运动队的各自表述。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reading club had agreed on voluntary attendance. One member questions a later compulsory requirement as inconsistent with that agreement; another favours retaining the arrangement to sustain the activity. Both might understand their reasons as concern for the club. The mean settles neither facts nor belonging. This voluntary-club example separates commitment from conduct without replacing the items’ distinct country, community and sports-team referents.

title.en: Name the group and the boundary

paragraphs.zh: 可写一张虚构讨论卡，列出群体、共同目标、具体分歧和仍需核对的事实。问：“是在讨论一个办法，还是已经把对方整个人排除？”只讨论例子与原则，不测试真实个人是否忠诚，也不用结果要求他人加入、留下或表态。
paragraphs.en: Draft an invented card naming the group, shared aim, disputed action and facts to check. Ask whether the discussion concerns a method or excludes a whole person. Discuss the example and principle without testing allegiance or using a result to demand membership, continued participation or a declaration.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构手工课中，资深成员建议先画草图，新成员问能否说明这样做的理由。询问理由可以与尊重经验同时存在；最后是否采用建议，还要看任务条件和角色范围。赞同向长辈学习，不自动意味着每项建议都正确；选择听从一次建议也不证明无条件服从。六题汇总对不同对象的观点，不能决定课堂、家庭或机构中的真实权责。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an experienced craft-class participant suggests sketching first and a newcomer asks why. Asking can coexist with respect for experience; adopting the advice still depends on task conditions and role scope. Valuing learning from elders establishes no correctness of every suggestion, and following one suggestion proves no unconditional deference. Six items summarise views on different referents without deciding actual responsibilities in a class, family or institution.

title.en: Make the condition for respect explicit
title.zh: 明确尊重所依赖的条件

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构建议写“我重视的经验或角色”“这次建议的理由”“仍需核对的范围”。讨论时问：“尊重这个人，具体需要同意哪一项主张吗？”不从均分替真实家人或领导发出指令，也不把提出问题的人判成不尊重。
paragraphs.en: For invented advice, list the valued experience or role, the reason for this suggestion and scope still to check. Ask whether respect for the person requires agreement with a specific claim. Issue no directions to real relatives or leaders from a mean and label no questioner disrespectful.

title.en: A feeling and a moral conclusion are different

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：两位虚构读者对故事里不熟悉的表达都感到不自在。一位把它留作私人感受，另一位认为它触及某条应当说明的规则。感受相近，不意味着得出同样道德结论；主张有规则，也仍需说明规则及适用条件。这个语言例子不能代表全部六题，更不能把对不同题目的反应拼成对某个人身体、身份、健康或私生活的评价。均分记录观点，不提供这类判断的依据。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two fictional readers feel uneasy about an unfamiliar expression in a story. One keeps it as a private reaction; another connects it with a rule needing explanation. Similar reactions need not yield the same moral conclusion, and a proposed rule still needs its terms stated. This language example represents no entire six-item group and combines no responses into a judgment of anyone’s body, identity, health or private life. The mean supplies no basis for those judgments.

title.en: Separate your reaction from your claim
title.zh: 将自身反应与所作主张分开

paragraphs.zh: 可在虚构例子旁分写“我的反应”“我作出的主张”“主张还需要的条件”，第三栏可以保留未知。讨论句是：“这句话在报告感受，还是断言别人应该怎样？”只讨论文字，不索取私人经历，不根据药物相关题目作健康决定，也不按高低分评价价值。
paragraphs.en: For an invented example, separate your reaction, a claim and conditions the claim still needs; unknown is allowed. Ask whether a sentence reports a feeling or directs someone else’s conduct. Discuss the words without personal disclosures, health decisions from the medicine item or score-based judgments of worth.
